builds.goal: Reference for Nocturne: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A dive attacker who selects an isolated target, stays on a damage trail and blocks a spell long enough to finish a fear tether. Record passive cleave cadence, fear tether and shielded spell. A burst R pick must repay the survival lost when landing in several opponents. Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.

testPlan: Kit question for Nocturne: Record passive cleave cadence, fear tether and shielded spell. A burst R pick must repay the survival lost when landing in several opponents.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

builds.name: Fear AP drain
builds.summary: Test AP payoff on the tether and repeated passive heals.
builds.goal: Test AP payoff on the tether and repeated passive heals.
builds.hypothesis: E deals 1 AP magic damage over two seconds and passive healing includes 0.3 AP per target. W's successful block doubles its attack speed bonus, potentially accelerating passive cooldown reduction through actual attacks. Nashor, Riftmaker and Cosmic test this sustained contact route.
testPlan: Required state: Unbroken E tether, a timed blocked spell and recorded passive cooldown.
Log E damage and passive heal per target, then attacks required to reset passive with W blocked versus unblocked.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Losing Q/R physical threat may prevent reaching a target or surviving the first trade.

builds.goal: Use R to begin a finite burst of fast attacks while maintaining the fear tether.
builds.hypothesis: Paranoia supplies target access, then Fiendhunter grants three enhanced basic attacks after ultimate use. Q's trail supplies AD and speed; Stridebreaker's slow can keep E attached. BotRK supports these real attacks and Cleaver supports physical damage after ramp.
